name: Shopify
summary: Shopify's own guide describes a Life Story conversation, a coding exercise, a pair-programming session and a technical deep dive. Recent candidates report pair-programming rounds where AI tools are allowed and problems such as a robot or rover command simulator grow in steps.

rounds.name: Recruiter call
rounds.what: Interest in Shopify and an overview of the process.

rounds.name: Life Story
rounds.what: Conversation with a recruiter about your personal and professional path, motivations and recurring themes.

rounds.name: Coding exercise
rounds.what: Paired problem in CoderPad aimed at a working solution, with edge cases discussed aloud.

rounds.name: Pair programming
rounds.what: You drive while a Shopify developer observes; recent reports say AI tools are allowed and requirements are added over time.

rounds.name: Technical deep dive
rounds.what: Discuss one or two past projects: impact, architecture, decisions, trade-offs and lessons.

rounds.name: System design
rounds.what: Senior and staff only, and not always held: practical design tied to Shopify's business.

tips: Ask clarifying questions before coding and narrate your reasoning.
Run your code often; a working, thoughtful solution beats a polished but fragile one.
Structure code so new requirements can be added without a rewrite.
If AI tools are allowed, gather requirements first and review its output for bugs.
For the deep dive, pick team projects you remember well, not side projects.

caveat: Built from public candidate reports. Processes differ by team and change over time.
